historyCoverage: Complete modern World Aquatics Championships medal and historical performance archive (2007–2024).

records.margin: Doha, Qatar; Pan Zhanle broke 100m Free World Record (46.80) in relay lead-off
Fukuoka, Japan; Léon Marchand broke Michael Phelps's last remaining World Record (400m IM in 4:02.50); Mollie O'Callaghan broke 200m Free WR
Budapest, Hungary; Katie Ledecky won 4 golds; Thomas Ceccon broke 100m Backstroke World Record (51.60)
Gwangju, South Korea; Caeleb Dressel won record 8 medals (6 gold) and broke Phelps's 100m Butterfly WR (49.50)
Budapest, Hungary; Caeleb Dressel tied Phelps's record with 7 golds at a single World Championships; Sarah Sjöström 51.71 100m Free WR
Kazan, Russia; Katie Ledecky completed unprecedented distance freestyle sweep (200m, 400m, 800m, 1500m Free)
Palau Sant Jordi, Barcelona; Missy Franklin won 6 gold medals; Sun Yang won 3 distance golds
Shanghai, China; Ryan Lochte broke first post-supersuit World Record (200m IM 1:54.00) and won 5 golds; Sun Yang broke 1500m Free WR
Foro Italico, Rome; 'Plastic Games' polyurethane super-suit era; 43 World Records shattered; Michael Phelps 100m Fly 49.82; Paul Biedermann 200m Free 1:42.00
Rod Laver Arena, Melbourne; Michael Phelps won 7 gold medals with 5 World Records in dominant warmup for Beijing 2008
